title: What came between Ayutthaya Kingdom and Rattanakosin Kingdom?
question: What came between Ayutthaya Kingdom and Rattanakosin Kingdom?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Ayutthaya Kingdom (1350) to Rattanakosin Kingdom (1782): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.

records.description: fourth traditional centre of power in the history of Thailand (1782 to 24 June 1932)
